مُصْلِدٌ : see صَلْدٌ. ―
-b2- [Hence,] one says, لَيْسَ بِمُصْلِدِ القَدْحِ [lit. He is not one whose wood gives only a sound when one endeavours to produce fire from it; meaning (assumed tropical:) he is not one who ungenerously refuses when asked]; an expression of praise; (TA in art. كسر;) and [in like manner] القَدْحِ ↓ لَيْسَ بِصَلَّادِ . (TA. in art. هش.) ＝
-A2- Also Milk milked into a greasy vessel, and therefore without froth. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
